document.title: The Scott Trial, Final Results (sections sheet)
document.software: unnamed scoring app used by Richmond Motor Club (ReportLab PDF)
discrepancies: The final instructions (TSR18 paragraph) say a driver who misses any section is automatically disqualified from the results, yet the two MS riders (nos 150 and 88) are printed with positions 118 and 119, after the OOT riders.
Row 203 'charity team' is DNF although all 76 sections carry a mark (Sec 76).
Award 12 on the companion awards sheet carries a note about the app's award selector; not on this sheet.
document.notes: Heading prints 'Final Results | Published 2026-10-18 17:39'. Event date printed as '17-10-26'. Companion documents: times sheet and awards sheet, linked by riding number.

rule_sets.name: Scott Trial: time and observation, TSR 22B amended

codes.meaning: section missed; adds nothing to Obs; the rider's status becomes MS

section_scale.notes: No 10 or 50 appears in any cell on the sheet.

penalties.as_printed: Drivers must be prepared to attempt a section when called upon. Penalty for non-compliance 5 marks lost.
A DRIVER WILL INCUR A PENALTY OF 50 marks if he does not make a genuine attempt to complete any section. A subsequent 50-mark penalty will disqualify the rider from the results
If a driver misses any section, then he will be automatically disqualified from the results.

time.conversion: 1 mark per minute or part minute slower than standard time (inferred from the times sheet: 04:51:18 = 0, 04:57:01 = 6, 04:57:57 = 7)
time.notes: Over-time (OOT) applies above 150 time marks: 07:21:14 (150 marks) is in time, 07:21:53 (151 marks) is OOT. Inferred; the instructions only describe course closure at petrol checks.

source.title: ACU Trials Standing Regulations 2023 v1 and Scott Trial final instructions 2026

rule_sets.notes: Non-stop marking and penalties are stated in the final instructions; the time conversion, the OOT limit and the tie-break are inferred. The tie-break was worked out from the 13 split ties on the sheet: fewer observation marks is ahead in every one, while most cleans first (ACU TSR 23A) fails in 2.

parts.label: single run of 76 sections
parts.notes: The sheet has no lap or day structure; the times sheet calls the run 'Day 1'.

totals.note: Section 31 printed '-' (missed). Obs 192 equals the sum of the other 75 cells, so the missed section added no marks.
76 sections marked yet DNF; no finish time on the times sheet.

entries.notes: Printed in the Rider column as 'charity team' with club Richmond and no machine. A team on one riding number; members are not named. DNF with all 76 sections marked and 0 time marks; the times sheet shows a start time and no finish.

totals.note: Printed with Time 0, Obs 0, Tot 0 and position 184.

misfits.what: The over-time limit is relative to standard time (fastest finisher plus 150 minutes, inferred), not an absolute course time.
misfits.suggestion: Add time.limit {value_s, relative_to: 'start' | 'standard-time'} or a time_marks_cap, and keep course_limit_s for absolute limits.

misfits.what: Ranking groups by status first (classified, OOT, MS, DNF, DNS), then sections ridden for DNF, then total. order_by is free text, so a consumer cannot rebuild the order.
misfits.suggestion: Give order_by a small vocabulary: status_order [list of statuses], sections_ridden desc, metric asc, tie_break.

misfits.what: A missed section prints '-' in the grid and changes the rider's status (MS) instead of adding marks. A scale code can carry a value but not an effect on status.
misfits.suggestion: Add scale_code.effect, for example {status: 'missed-section'} or {dsq: true}.

misfits.what: Row 203 is a team on one riding number with no named members and a club column. entry.team holds the name; the club only fits representing, whose meaning differs from a rider's club.
misfits.suggestion: Allow entry.display_name and entry.club for entries without people, or say that representing.type 'club' is the club column.

misfits.what: A penalty that disqualifies on its second occurrence: penalty_rule has 'then' but no count of occurrences, and 'cap' does not say whether it is a value cap or an occurrence cap.
misfits.suggestion: Split cap into cap_value and then_after_occurrences.

misfits.what: Two riders on equal totals are placed 29 and 30 with no printed reason; row.tie_break needs a printed reason, so the separation is only a note.
The event date is printed '17-10-26'; event has no as_printed for dates.

mapping.unread: The 8 sampled rows were mapped by hand. The other 187 were added later by parsing the PDF text layer; each row's section count and Obs agree with its marks, and the parser's output matched all 8 hand-mapped rows.
